scope: Boston University Charles River main campus; exterior quality iteration
renderChanges: BU masonry uses per-piece facade orientation and foundation height after spatial batching.
BU glass uses a procedural view-dependent sky tint, not a captured environment or ray-traced reflection.
Urban tree crowns are interlocking opaque volumes with silhouette leaves and spatial culling; positions are unchanged.
The playable world and inspection camera share Boston daylight parameters.
Terrain, actual surfaces and painted markings have an explicit depth hierarchy, retained by the mobile bake.

mobile.runtime: Offline welded geometry; no desktop procedural constructors are loaded on mobile. Default low quality and optional HD remain separate.

limits: Street-level facade families, tree forms and garden details are authored approximations, not per-address survey models.
Terrain remains the existing interpolated height field; this pass adds no new elevation survey.
Mobile uses selected landmark detail and simplified context geometry, rather than desktop visual parity.
Automated touch Chromium regression does not replace a physical iPhone Safari test.
